effect:
Powers up special moves. (Hold)

Wise Glasses provides a 10% boost to all special moves, regardless of type. It's the special attack equivalent of Muscle Band.

The 10% boost is smaller than type-specific items, but it applies to your entire special movepool. Good for mixed special attackers who use multiple types of special moves and want consistent value across all of them.
